_comment: The PUBLIC half of the Agent Card signing key, published at /.well-known/jwks.json and named by the jku in every signature's protected header. The private half is not in this repository and never will be; it lives at ~/.config/a2atraffic/signing-key.jwk, mode 0600, on one machine. If that file is lost the card cannot be re-signed and a new key must be published — which is a real single point of failure and is stated rather than hidden.
_kid_comment: kid is the RFC 7638 thumbprint of the key itself, not a name. A named kid can be reused after a rotation and quietly point at a different key; a thumbprint cannot, and launch-gate.mjs re-derives it rather than trusting it.
